question.text: Capital gain LTCG on transfer of Cat III AIF UNITS (if classified as 'equity-oriented investment fund') is taxed at:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.6, LTCG on AIF units of equity-oriented Cat III = 12.5% post-July 2024. **The Trap:** Other rates don't apply post-Finance Act 2024. **Cross-Exam Context:** Harmonized with equity LTCG regime. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Review holding-period records to ensure LTCG classification on unit transfers.
